semantics: Reuse exactly frozen predictions raw = clip(canonical byte baseline / 255 + trained correction,0,1). On previously registered eligible never-directly-seen non-base/non-tree cells only, encoder uses q8(raw) as before, Sapling-only decoder aux['est'] is f16(raw) promoted to float32 like original Feat; other cells preserve native original f16 aux values byte for byte. Base candidate SHA and constants checked. No weight fitting.
fields: Prefix._dest alone reads aux['est'][dest] into column 7 of its 15 move features. Worker rows NONE/UP/RIGHT/DOWN/LEFT each use the destination cell's carbon / 100 (not its four-neighbor mean). Base recruit rows 1/2 read the base itself, a fixed zero; other base rows are all zero. No unit feature depends on carbon. Within existing Sapling decoder this replaces column 7 in flattened move inputs to din/GRU and in the V(move) @ U(hidden) scoring path; return basis and both calls to it50 retain original move, aux and x. Existing safe branch choice and original 0.75/0.25 blending weights retained.
